critical_code_review_comments: MarketingStart.js lines 192-211: 'Cargando temas para tu negocio…' shows only on initial load; when saving a new industry via saveIndustry(), loadTopics() is awaited but the topics-grid is briefly empty in between. Acceptable, but could show a small inline spinner over the grid for nicer UX.
saveIndustry() (line 67) trims+validates but does not block 1-character or numeric-only inputs. Minor — backend likely guards this.

INDUSTRIES list is hardcoded in component (line 27). For maintainability, consider centralizing this list (also used implicitly by backend trade detection) in a single config or returning from backend.
